summary: Firefox tightened how WebRTC network traffic is allowed to leave the browser: outgoing port restrictions for WebRTC (both ICE-TCP and content-process UDP) are now enforced in the parent process and applied to remote ICE candidate destinations, improving security and policy compliance. The change also simplifies ALPN handling (the TLS protocol negotiation used for secure connections) and fixes handling of larger mDNS addresses (used for local network name discovery). These fixes reduce chances of mis-routed or disallowed connections and make local discovery more robust.
